Dates & sources

The delivery ZIP contains files dated 26 February–1 March 2013. Its credits identify me as the designer and developer; those file dates do not establish the launch date.

I designed and built a site for beta+, an electronic musician in Philadelphia. It brought the music, videos and upcoming shows together, with a blue masthead and a custom icon font.

The original delivery ZIP still has the HTML, styles and graphics. This preview shows the masthead, with a small fix to keep the logo from being cropped.
